heading: Let's work together.
intro: I work with leaders on what to build for customers and how to put AI to work inside their organizations. Bring me in for a focused project or work with me one-to-one.

offers.title: Executive AI advisory
offers.situation: You want to understand what AI makes possible for your role and use it with greater confidence.
offers.description: I work one-to-one with executives who want to use AI more effectively in their own work and make informed decisions about its role in their organization. Bring one priority. We work through it together using your questions and examples.
offers.proof: I build and use AI systems for research, planning, recurring operations, and product development in my own work.
topics: Put your AI meeting notes to work for decision preparation, follow-ups, and spotting patterns across conversations.
Use connectors to bring relevant documents, calendar context, and meeting notes into your AI workflow.
Build a research workflow that tracks industry shifts, competitors, and emerging technology, with sources you can check.
Explore plugins and create reusable skills for briefings, strategy reviews, and recurring work.
Make a dashboard, decision tool, or early prototype around a real business question.
Pressure-test a decision, prepare for a consequential conversation, or choose a first AI experiment for your team.
offers.outcome: A workflow you've practiced, a first version you've made, or a decision you've worked through, plus a short written recap and next steps. Further sessions or a larger engagement can be scoped together.

offers.title: Experience-Led Growth Sprint
offers.situation: Customer expectations are shifting. Your product or experience needs a clearer direction for what comes next.
offers.description: I work with leaders to identify where growth, relevance, and differentiation can come from next. We look at customer behavior, business priorities, and the role technology should play, then make the strongest opportunities tangible.
offers.proof: Reframed an app badging brief into an engagement strategy around customers' financial progress.
topics: Understand changing customer needs and where the current experience falls short.
Define opportunities across your product, service, membership, or wider customer experience.
Develop concepts or prototypes and prioritize what to test next.
offers.outcome: A shared strategic direction, concepts your team can evaluate, and a prioritized path forward.
offers.proofQuote: She helped us think in terms of how to bring real customer value in a space that is often purely transactional.
offers.proofRole: Director of UX Design, Ally Bank

offers.title: AI adoption and enablement
offers.situation: Build the capabilities to match your AI ambitions.
offers.description: I work with leaders and teams to understand what their AI ambitions require in practice, drawing on behavior design. We build and test workflows, develop people’s expertise, and design how people and AI coordinate work across a team. That includes ownership, handoffs, working rhythms, and incentives.
offers.format: Scoped to your team and work
offers.proof: Built emerging-technology practices and AI workflows, working with leaders and teams as new ways of working took hold.
topics: Understand the work. Identify where expertise lives, how decisions get made, and what helps or prevents people from adopting new practices.
Build capability through practice. Develop and test AI-enabled workflows with the people using them, strengthening their ability to create, question outputs, and evaluate quality.
Move from individual use to team collaboration. Design how people and AI share context, coordinate tasks, and hand work over, with clear ownership and points for human judgment.
Make adoption sustainable. Establish working rhythms, incentives, and shared standards that support continued learning and accountability.
offers.outcome: A defined use case, a tested approach, and clear recommendations for the practices and capabilities your team needs next.

testimonial.quote: Customers, engineers, and executives all trusted her judgment.
testimonial.name: Mansoor Basha

contactBody: If your project crosses a few of these areas, tell me what you're working on. We can figure out the right engagement together.
